description: This PHP file defines the 'ViewHome' class, which is responsible for rendering the home/dashboard view within the SuiteCRM Module Builder. The class manages display logic, including setting up Smarty templates, generating UI buttons based on user permissions, and integrating with AJAX components.

classes.name: ViewHome
classes.description: A class extending SugarView responsible for rendering the Module Builder's home page interface, including buttons and AJAX content.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, utilizing translation and module title functions.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the home page with Smarty templates, assigns variables, and integrates AJAX components.

methods.name: generateHomeButtons
methods.description: Creates action buttons on the home page based on user permissions and available Studio modules.
